question: For all patients who are older than 55 years old, what is the percentage of female who has abnormal prothrombin time (PT)?
evidence: older than 55 years old = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Birthday)) > 55; abnormal prothrombin time (PT) refers to PT > = 14; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(PT > = 14 AND SEX = 'F'), SUM(PT > = 14)) * 100; female refers to sex = 'F';
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching Laboratory record.
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PT >= 14 AND T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) > 55
gold0: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PT >= 14 AND T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) > 55

d.request: For all patients older than 55 years old (current year minus birth year > 55), what is the percentage of female patients (SEX = 'F') who have an abnormal prothrombin time (PT >= 14), calculated as the number of patients with PT >= 14 and SEX = 'F' divided by the number of patients with PT >= 14, multiplied by 100, while also keeping patients who have no matching Laboratory record (i.e., using a left join from Patient to Laboratory so those rows are retained)?
d.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND L.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage FROM Patient P LEFT JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 55

b.request: Among patients older than 55 (current year minus birth year > 55), using a LEFT JOIN from Patient to Laboratory so patients with no Laboratory record are kept, what percentage of those with PT >= 14 are female (SEX = 'F')?
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' THEN P.ID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS percentage FROM Patient P LEFT JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 55 AND L.PT >= 14
